raw_segments.text: I begin to think, said Estella, in amusing way after another moment of calm wonder, that
I almost understand how this comes about.
If you had brought up your adopted daughter wholly in the dark confinement of these rooms,
and had never let her know that there was such a thing as the daylight by which she
had never once seen your face, if you had done that, and then, for a purpose had wanted
her to understand the daylight and know all about it, you would have been disappointed
